Market today: Tech is still the main driver, but the AI spending spree is raising eyebrows with Moody's flagging risks for big players. Your sector is feeling the heat.
Your holdings: SOXL is deep in the red (-46.24%), and SPAL (-55.51%) is also a big loser. Both are leveraged and decaying, and your stops are way off. QQQ (-4.26%), QQQI (-6.52%), and SMH (-11.82%) are also under pressure.
Watch: Keep an eye on the 30-year Treasury yield potentially hitting 6%, which could really shake up the market.
Bottom line: You're heavily concentrated in a sector facing headwinds, and leverage is amplifying the pain.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL if you can stomach the loss. The leverage and decay are brutal, and current stops are useless.
Consider trimming QQQ and QQQI if they break their current levels.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
